rows.notes: Derived by listing coaches. The lower bound is Verified for 2024 only. The pooled 56% target rests on Wikipedia for 2022 (8 of 15: Nebraska, Arizona State, Georgia Tech, Colorado, Wisconsin, Charlotte, Auburn, South Florida) and 2023 (5 of 11: Michigan State, Texas A&M, Boise State, Mississippi State, Syracuse; Northwestern's July firing left out), with a partial cross-check from Front Porch Sports (Craig Meyer, 2025-10-17): 7 firings before November in 2022 and 1 in 2023, matching Wikipedia's dates. So the pooled target is 1 of 3 plus a partial check; the 2024 bound is Verified. Kennesaw State 2024 is disputed (school: stepped down; coach: fired); without it the USA Today list gives 6 of 13 (46%). Wikipedia's own 'in season' split counts from May 1, so summer firings were removed by hand. The design band before MA-77 was an Assumption of 15% to 40%.
